risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04o; BR-FUND-04 SB2–SB4, SB8, SB10; S8). Service-layer batch commands only (step-up and HTTP are B2-09): confirm all DRAFT batches of a bill's round at once (immediate or scheduled, SB2), cancel a schedule (SB3), reject (SB4), resume a PARTIAL batch (SB8, both switches on and the day's snapshot complete or timed out), manual start always refused (SB10 with TODO blocked on finance confirmation). Status changes only through the generated settle-batch transition() with row_version CAS; conflicts map to 20902 settle_batch. The Clock is read after the row locks and the accounting date is re-checked before the write, so a wait across midnight re-validates against the new day (money round 1). No money movement, no balance or voucher writes. Only apps/api/src/modules/settlement/batch/commands/** changed.
